title: Dovin Turns the Azorius Against Ravnica's Defenders
summary: Bolas's ally uses the Senate's civic authority to suppress opposition before the invasion.
narrative: Dovin Baan's rise within the Azorius Senate gave Bolas a powerful accomplice in Ravnica's political institutions.
Administrative obstruction and the misuse of order weakened the city's ability to act together before the Eternals arrived.
His role illustrates how the conspiracy exploited internal division alongside interplanar magic.

The Azorius Senate was a natural target because administrative systems can determine who is heard, which threats receive attention, and whether rival factions can coordinate. Dovin's talent for identifying institutional weaknesses made him useful to Bolas even before the invading Eternals could be seen on Ravnica's streets.

Control of a guild did not imply control of every inhabitant or member. The significance was structural: policies and leadership decisions could redirect a large civic institution away from collective defense. Resistance thus faced not only a hostile foreign power but also familiar offices and procedures serving that power's interests.

The pre-invasion manipulation explains why defeating Bolas did not by itself restore civic confidence. A city that had been attacked through its own government also had to deal with questions of accountability, damaged trust, and which institutions should be allowed to wield authority after the immediate emergency ended.
